title: raster operation witness lifecycle
why: A document that composites an `engine:<surface>` raster made this authority reachable for the first time. The commit re-read the candidate/presentation witness pair on EVERY retirement step, so the moment its own cursor consumed the first field of the candidate slot the comparison failed and the frame refused its own progress with `raster commit candidate witness was stale` — quarantining the surface at ~7.8 s on every boot (ticket 26/09/09/PROCEDURAL-3D-END-TO-END).

rules.name: a surface with no raster yet owes nothing
rules.reason: an engine surface whose first raster has not been reserved is NOT YET, never stale

rules.name: a later operation cannot commit an earlier candidate
rules.fault: raster retirement candidate witness was stale

rules.name: a presentation from another operation
rules.fault: raster retirement presentation witness was stale

presentation.armsOnlyItsOwnCandidate: raster candidate witness was stale before presentation
presentation.refusesASecondArming: raster presentation witness was already occupied
